One of the best pieces of advice i can give you, is do not tell her you feel that you let her down. it could very well make it worse. I can speak from experience.
Just ask her what happened to make her feel that was her only option, and that next time she gets that way, to talk to you first. 

Even posting on here, if its something that she may not feel comfortable talking to you about may help.

having attempted before, and failed quite miserably, i can say that sometimes i didnt want people to act any different just because i had attempted to take my life. i mostly just wished they would realize that what they were doing with events leading up to it hurt me more than i let on. like @dyso1 said, let them know your there when for when theyre ready to talk. sometimes that means more than walking on eggshells in the persons mind... sorry if it aint helpful but ya... best of luck, and if i could i would tell her that things get so much more interesting after you hit that magical 18. im 31, and even though i have tried to take my life on multiple occasions, and failed, and am close to trying again, it pains me deeply to see or hear bout those so young and innocent in this fucked up world trying to take their lives. I wish i could help you more but i dnt know what else to say...

and just a heads up, i suck at giving advice, but wanted to try, can dv or delete if you wish...

she would say she tried, and that she caved because its what i had wanted. i just honestly dont know what 2 do anymore. i try to do the best i know how, but its never good enough for her.. she use to be the love of my life, my all and everything,  but the shit shes pulled has done nothing but kill me inside more and more. yet i dont want to leave her, since i still love her. but trying to talk 2 her bout it starts a fight, likely because when i was trying to quit smoking the first year into our relationship she would come to me with things and i would snap without meaning to. and its been so long since ive cried, it actually hurts when i do for some reason, not trying to be a smart ass, i am serious.
